explain.en: Installers Homebrew has downloaded, plus its cached package index. Moving this folder only removes downloads: installed programs keep working, and Homebrew downloads again what it needs next time. The brew command shown below does more: it also uninstalls old versions of installed programs and dependencies nothing needs any more. Add --dry-run to see what it would remove first.
explain.zh: Homebrew 下载过的安装包和缓存的软件列表。挪走这个文件夹只是删掉下载的东西：装好的程序照常能用，下次需要时 Homebrew 会重新下载。下面那条 brew 命令做得更多：还会卸掉已装程序的旧版本和不再需要的依赖，可以先加 --dry-run 看看它会删什么。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 2.6G, of which downloads/ 2.5G; `brew --cache` (Homebrew 7.0.8) prints this path. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: HOMEBREW_CACHE is normally set in a shell profile, which an app opened from the Finder does not see; the default path is always scanned too.
